xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5502: docs: accuracy audit, Features (14 pages)

narratives.Problem: The Features docs pages describe removed views (mission-control Activity View, Badge Bar, Status Reviews), removed skills and subagents, wrong pan handoff flags, a test agent that is never dispatched, wrong workspace paths and planning artifacts, stale screenshots, and wrong merge-train behavior. Several pages have en/em dashes, generic titles and broken links.
narratives.Proposal: The planner already audited all 20 pages in the Features nav group against main 2007e9a4d3c; .pan/drafts/PAN-5502.md holds verified change tables (grep anchor, replacement, code evidence) per page in Appendices A to J. One item per page (three section items for conversations.mdx, two for workspaces.mdx) applies its table, removes dashes, fixes frontmatter, deletes images of removed UI and checks links; a final item runs lint:docs and the Mintlify validators and drafts the per-page PR body. One PR.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code, test, rule, docs.json, CLAUDE.md, README.md or changelog.d change; code bugs become PR-body Follow-ups.
- No page outside the Features nav group.
- No new pages, navigation changes, file renames or slug changes.
- No heading renames or deletions except those listed in the PRD's NFR-2.
- No screenshots added, replaced or recaptured and no image files deleted; only alt text changes and the ThemedImage removals listed in FR-8.
- No help section added to pages without a troubleshooting section.
- No change to the macOS ⌘W/⌘T shortcut lines (needs a real-Mac check).
- No description of intended behavior as current (for example #5537's test dispatch).

autoDecisions.summary: Audit all 20 pages in the Features nav group, not only the 14 listed
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's scope sentence is every published page in the group; the six added pages are in no sibling audit issue's body, and PAN-5503 made the same call.

autoDecisions.summary: Audit the five prerequisite-PR pages on top of their merged results, including swarm.mdx
autoDecisions.rationale: All of #5474, #5472, #5471, #5479 and #5482 merged and their commits are in each page's history; PAN-5482 landed, so its result is audited with six small rows.

autoDecisions.summary: Add Discord and GitHub Issues links only to pages with troubleshooting sections lacking them
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the links where a page talks about getting help; skill-packs, convoys and workspaces are the only such pages without them.

autoDecisions.summary: Rewrite wrong alt text, delete ThemedImage blocks that show removed UI, list recaptures as Follow-ups
autoDecisions.rationale: A screenshot of a removed harness picker is a wrong claim; recapturing images needs a live dashboard and is outside a text audit.

autoDecisions.summary: Retitle generic one- or two-word titles and keep the old title as sidebarTitle
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for specific searchable titles; sidebarTitle keeps navigation labels short, matching PAN-5503.

autoDecisions.summary: Describe current code behavior where code is buggy and list the bug as a Follow-up
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is docs-only; describing intended behavior (for example test dispatch after approval, #5537) would reintroduce inaccuracy.

autoDecisions.summary: Split conversations.mdx into three section items and workspaces.mdx into two, chained by blocks edges
autoDecisions.rationale: conversations.mdx is 1,346 lines with 48 rows and workspaces.mdx has 35 rows; section items stay reviewable and the edges serialize shared-file edits.

metadata.sizeJustification: Every item edits one Mintlify page in the single features/ directory; the finalize lint counts each features/<page>.mdx as its own subsystem, so 20 pages read as 20 subsystems. The epic (#5467) scopes one audit issue per docs nav group, and the pages share one validation pass and one PR body, so splitting into sibling issues would duplicate the validator and PR-body work without adding review isolation. The plan touches exactly 20 files, under the 25-file limit.
